images.title: Six slots of 26 letters
images.purpose: Shows a lock with 6 letter slots, each with 26 choices, giving 26 to the power 6 passwords.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text. A row of six lock slots across the centre with the count under each, and the total below.
images.exact_structure: One long grey (#6B7280) rounded rectangle (the lock body) holding exactly 6 equal teal (#0072B2) slot windows in a row, each window showing the letter 'A'. Under each window, the number '26', with a '×' sign between neighbouring numbers (5 times signs). A thin amber (#E69F00) brace under the six numbers with the label '6 slots'. Below the brace, the label '26⁶' and then '308915776' in a reddish purple (#CC79A7) rounded box. Exactly 6 windows, six 26s, 5 times signs, 1 brace, 1 box.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each slot multiplies the choices again: 6 slots of 26 letters give 26 to the power 6 passwords.
images.description: Shows a lock with 6 letter slots, each with 26 choices, giving 26 to the power 6 passwords.

image_decisions.why: Slots multiplying their choices is the idea behind counting codes and passwords.
